about: What's new, newest first. Plain words for pharmacy staff: what they will notice. Each id is unique and never reused; add new entries at the top.

entries.title: Numbers that never repeat, and help that matches the screen
entries.text: A new question or delivery takes the number after the highest one already saved, so a new device never starts again at 00001. Just after midnight, the old dashboard's Add to Stock and a supplier's delivery date now take Malta's day, not yesterday. The guide behind the ? on every screen uses that screen's own button names, and says only what is really still in the classic screen.

entries.title: Nothing lost while a screen loads, and more you can change
entries.text: What you type or choose stays put while a screen is still loading, and the cursor stays where you are. When the connection drops, a banner says so and nothing is saved twice. End of day prints on one A4 page, and a closed day can be unlocked. A credit note that was used by mistake can be put back. Order diary items and price quotes can be changed or deleted, and Returns has New return. The standing instructions can be changed in Handover, and Plan shifts takes new leave requests. Labels and headings are no longer in capitals.

entries.title: Quicker forms and a search that opens them
entries.text: Orders, deliveries and tickets have Today, Tomorrow and next working day buttons. The cleaner's name is ready on Today. In End of day, Enter moves to the next amount. Search for "new order" or "ask" and the right form opens. A new pharmacy sets up its fridges, people and products without the old screens. From Customers, forms open with the person filled in, and the cursor is never lost: N opens a new form and Ctrl+Enter saves it.

entries.title: Inspection check
entries.text: Registers › Inspection check shows, for the days you choose, whether every register is in order: days not logged, notes missing, certificates due. It prints on one page with lines to sign, and it is the first page of the inspection pack.

entries.title: Put a wrong line right
entries.text: The pharmacist can press Correct on a register line, change what was wrong and say why. The line stays in the register, and Eikon keeps what it said before, who changed it and why.

entries.title: Repeat prescriptions coming due
entries.text: Write how often a patient collects, for example every 28 days. Repeat prescriptions shows when each one is next due, Today lists who is due, and Collected today marks it, with undo.

entries.title: Notes for readings outside the limits
entries.text: On Today, a reading outside its limits asks what was done, with quick choices to pick from. In Temperature, tap a day to see it or add a note. A missed day can be logged late, saying why.

entries.title: Typing is no longer lost
entries.text: When Eikon fills in a patient's name or a reg no. for you, what you type next in the following box stays there.

entries.title: Big pharmacies: faster saving
entries.text: Saving point-of-care tests, screening and adverse reactions is faster in pharmacies with many records, and so is bringing in a long list at once.

entries.title: Clearer forms
entries.text: A form now says everything that is missing at once and marks each box. A screen that could not open offers Try again, and buttons are easier to tap on a phone.

entries.title: Help for every screen
entries.text: Press the ? beside a screen's name for a short guide to it. Settings › Help & guides lists them all, with a search.

entries.title: What's new
entries.text: This list. A dot on Settings shows when something has changed since you last looked.

entries.title: Past months on every register
entries.text: Use ‹ and › or the month's name above a register to see an earlier month, then Print to print it.

entries.title: Everyone signs in as themselves
entries.text: The pharmacist can add a person, give a new password or switch someone off in Team › People who sign in. A person's name stays on everything they recorded.

entries.title: Lock when idle
entries.text: Settings › Lock when idle covers the screen after a few quiet minutes. It is off unless you turn it on.

entries.title: Readings outside the limits stand out
entries.text: On Today, a fridge or room reading outside its limits shows in red, with a reminder to add a note. Times are Malta time, whatever the device's clock says.

entries.title: Eikon on your desktop or home screen
entries.text: Eikon offers to add itself, so it opens with one tap in its own window. You can also do it from Settings. The old address now takes you to eikonhq.com.

entries.title: Small fixes
entries.text: Dispensing labels save only the new label. End of day saves the bank bag counts correctly. Clear in the warfarin calculator works again.

entries.title: Today stays open
entries.text: Signing out on another device no longer leaves Today blank here.

entries.title: Names start with capitals
entries.text: A name typed all in small letters is written with a capital for each word: john agius becomes John Agius.

entries.title: Money today
entries.text: Today has a Money today tile.

entries.title: Back to the new layout
entries.text: The classic layout has a Use the new layout button.

entries.title: Emergency numbers
entries.text: Contacts lists 112 for ambulance, police and fire. The old 196 number is gone.

entries.title: ID cards kept straight
entries.text: When you type an ID card nobody has, Eikon asks before adding the person. It stops you if the card belongs to someone else. A card can be changed on all of a person's records at once, with undo.

entries.title: Search that takes you there
entries.text: Press / anywhere to search screens, people, orders and bookings. Enter opens the one you want. Scanning an ID card opens the person.

entries.title: Faster to open
entries.text: Eikon opens faster, most of all on a phone with a weak signal.

entries.title: Problems reach us by themselves
entries.text: If a screen goes wrong, Eikon tells us, so it can be put right sooner.

entries.title: Download our records
entries.text: Settings › Download our records gives your registers for any days as a spreadsheet to keep, or printed for an inspector. For the pharmacist.

entries.title: Controlled drug stock takes
entries.text: Stock takes of controlled drugs now open in the new layout, under Registers. They print as before.

entries.title: Orders: phone, pick-up day and deposit
entries.text: Orders taken in the new layout from late on 2 November until midday on 3 November lost their phone number, pick-up day and deposit. This is fixed. Please add them again to those orders.

entries.title: Suggestions as you type
entries.text: In the registers, typing part of an ID card or a name offers the person. Choosing them fills only the empty boxes.

entries.title: Services and Money have their own tabs
entries.text: Clinical work and the till moved out of Registers. On a phone, Team, Services and Money are under More.

entries.title: Controlled drugs by brand name
entries.text: In the controlled drug registers, typing a brand finds the medicine: "ativ" offers Lorazepam (Ativan).

entries.title: More screens in the new layout
entries.text: Screening campaigns, Contraceptive pills, Dispensing labels, Supplier stock, Over the counter, Emergency POS, Pharmacy calculators and Possible duplicates.

entries.title: More screens in the new layout
entries.text: Chat board, End of day, Vaccines, Contacts, Plan shifts, Point-of-care tests, Scarce stock, Audit trail and Adverse reactions.

entries.title: The new layout for every pharmacy
entries.text: Every pharmacy now opens in the new layout. Settings › Classic layout brings back the old one on that browser.

entries.title: No more waiting for the intro
entries.text: Eikon opens as soon as it is ready, and people already signed in go straight in.
